mcp_tool_approval_safety_basis.rationale: MCP tool auto-approval is safe here only because the hash-pinned server exposes exactly one tool: the operator terminal is bounded by the frozen broker, while the grader evidence tool is read-only.

noninteractive_approval_safety_basis.rationale: Non-interactive approval is safe here only because Codex intrinsic action features are disabled and operator sessions expose exactly one MCP terminal bounded by the frozen broker; grader sessions expose exactly one read-only evidence tool.
